data.one_liner: Embed extensions for flutter_quill to support loading images and videos
data.what_it_does: Provides embed builders and toolbar extensions for the flutter_quill rich text editor to support loading, displaying, and picking images and videos. It handles platform-specific image/video requirements and includes resizing and alignment features.
use_when: You are using flutter_quill and need to support inserting and displaying images and videos.
You need standard media pickers and platform-native video playback integrated within your text editor.
avoid_when: You only need basic text editing without media embedding capabilities.
strengths: Seamlessly integrates with flutter_quill for rich media support.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Built-in image asset loading and network image support.
weaknesses: Requires configuration of native permissions and platform setup for media pickers and networking.
Limited support for custom image and video element properties.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions in AndroidManifest.xml for internet/network access, Info.plist entries for macOS, and configuring quill_native_bridge, image_picker, and video_player.
